parts.name: Part 1
parts.dir: PART 1 지시문: 각 문항마다 사진 한 장에 대한 네 개의 설명을 듣게 됩니다. 설명은 한 번만 들려주며 시험지에 인쇄되어 있지 않습니다. 사진을 가장 잘 묘사한 설명을 고르세요.

say.t: (A) Several people are seated along a conference table.
(B) Some chairs are being stacked against a wall.
(C) A woman is writing on a whiteboard.
(D) The participants are shaking hands across the table.

items.ex: 여러 사람이 긴 회의 테이블에 앉아 있는 모습이 사진의 중심이다. 여자는 화면 앞에 서 있을 뿐 화이트보드에 '쓰고 있는' 동작은 없어 동사 함정.

say.t: (A) A screen is being installed at the front of the room.
(B) Some people are watching a presentation.
(C) Some armchairs are stacked in a corner.
(D) Chairs have been lined up along the walls.

items.ex: 의자들이 양쪽 벽을 따라 줄지어 놓인 '상태'를 have been p.p.로 정확히 묘사했다. 사람이 없는 사진에서 is being installed(설치되는 중)는 진행 수동태 함정.

say.t: (A) A man is closing one of the windows.
(B) Some desks are being moved toward the windows.
(C) A man is standing in an aisle between rows of desks.
(D) Some students are putting books on a shelf.

items.ex: 남자 한 명이 책상 줄 사이 통로에 서 있는 모습과 일치한다. 창문은 보이지만 남자가 창문을 '닫는' 동작은 없으므로 사진 속 사물을 이용한 동사 함정.

say.t: (A) Chairs have been stacked on top of the desks.
(B) Some workers are sitting at their desks.
(C) A monitor has been mounted on the wall.
(D) Some plants are being watered.

items.ex: 벽에 TV 모니터가 걸려 있는 상태를 정확히 묘사했다. 사람이 없는 사무실이므로 being watered(물을 주는 중)처럼 사람 동작이 필요한 진행 수동태는 오답.

say.t: (A) A server is bringing plates of food to a table.
(B) Some people are gathered around a table.
(C) Some cups are being filled with coffee.
(D) Some people are reaching for books on a shelf.

items.ex: 남녀 여러 명이 테이블에 둘러앉아 있으므로 gathered around a table이 정답. 뒤에 책장은 보이지만 책을 '꺼내려는' 동작은 없어 사물 연상 함정.

say.t: (A) A path is covered with fallen leaves.
(B) A man is raking leaves into a pile.
(C) A man is taking off his backpack.
(D) Some trees are being trimmed along the path.

items.ex: 낙엽이 깔린 길을 is covered with fallen leaves로 묘사했다. 낙엽과 남자가 보인다고 raking(갈퀴질하는 중)을 고르면 동사 함정에 걸린다.

parts.name: Part 2
parts.dir: PART 2 지시문: 질문 또는 진술 하나와 그에 대한 세 개의 응답을 영어로 듣게 됩니다. 음성은 한 번만 들려주며 시험지에 인쇄되어 있지 않습니다. 질문 또는 진술에 가장 알맞은 응답을 고르세요.

say.t: When is the new expense software going live?
(A) Yes, I live just down the street.
(B) The IT team hasn't confirmed a date yet.
(C) It was much more expensive than I thought.

items.ex: 시행 시점을 묻는 질문에 '아직 날짜 미확정'으로 간접 응답했다. expense–expensive, live 반복은 소리 함정.

say.t: Who's leading the client call this afternoon?
(A) Didn't Haruka volunteer for it?
(B) At two thirty, I believe.
(C) The call was recorded for training.

items.ex: Who 질문에 '하루카가 자원하지 않았나요?'라는 되묻기로 사람을 제시했다. At two thirty는 When에 대한 답이라 의문사 함정.

say.t: Why don't we book the larger meeting room for Friday?
(A) Because it's on the fifth floor.
(B) The sales team already has it that day.
(C) I finished that book last week.

items.ex: Why don't we는 제안이므로 '그날은 영업팀이 이미 쓴다'는 거절성 응답이 자연스럽다. Because로 시작하는 보기는 Why를 이유 질문으로 착각하게 만드는 함정.

say.t: Where can I charge my electric car around here?
(A) The parking garage on Elm Street has a few spots.
(B) About forty minutes for a full battery.
(C) There's no extra charge for delivery.

items.ex: 충전 장소를 묻자 Elm Street 주차장을 제시했다. charge(요금)를 반복한 보기는 다의어 함정.

say.t: Should I print the handouts, or will you share them online?
(A) Most people prefer digital copies these days.
(B) He shared an office with me last year.
(C) Yes, they're on the table.

items.ex: 선택의문문에 '요즘은 다들 디지털 사본을 선호한다'로 온라인 공유를 간접 선택했다. 선택의문문에 Yes로 답하는 보기는 오답.

say.t: How often is the warehouse inventory updated?
(A) About two hundred boxes.
(B) The system does it automatically every night.
(C) In the warehouse on Route 9.

items.ex: 빈도를 묻는 How often에 '매일 밤 자동으로'라고 답했다. warehouse를 반복한 장소 응답은 소리 함정.

say.t: Isn't the design team switching to the new AI drafting tool?
(A) The toolbox is in the storage room.
(B) I'll draft the e-mail right now.
(C) Only for the first round of sketches.

items.ex: 부정의문문에 '초기 스케치에만 쓴다'는 부분 긍정으로 답했다. tool–toolbox, draft 반복은 소리 함정.

say.t: I can't log in to the shared drive from home.
(A) She works from home on Fridays.
(B) The drive took about an hour.
(C) Have you set up two-step verification yet?

items.ex: 접속 문제를 말하자 '2단계 인증 설정했어요?'라는 되묻기로 원인을 짚었다. drive(운전)·home 반복은 다의어·소리 함정.

say.t: Which subscription plan did you choose for the team?
(A) We're still comparing the costs.
(B) The team won the regional award.
(C) Every month on the first.

items.ex: 어떤 요금제를 골랐는지 묻자 '아직 비용 비교 중'이라는 미정 응답을 했다. Every month는 구독 결제 주기를 연상시키는 함정.

say.t: Would you mind reviewing my slides before the meeting?
(A) No, I didn't mind the noise.
(B) Last week's meeting ran long.
(C) Can it wait until after lunch?

items.ex: 검토 부탁에 '점심 이후로 미뤄도 될까요?'라고 되물으며 조건부 수락했다. mind를 반복한 보기는 소리 함정.

say.t: The delivery vans are all being replaced with electric models, right?
(A) The models are on display downstairs.
(B) Only the ones on the city routes.
(C) I'll deliver it to you myself.

items.ex: 전부 교체되는지 확인하자 '도심 노선 차량만'이라고 범위를 좁혀 답했다. models(모형)·deliver 반복은 소리 함정.

say.t: What time does the shuttle to the convention center leave?
(A) About fifty participants.
(B) In the center of town.
(C) There's a schedule posted by the front desk.

items.ex: 출발 시간을 묻자 '프런트 옆 시간표를 보라'고 정보 출처를 알려 주는 간접 응답. center 반복은 소리 함정.

say.t: Do you know if Mr. Okafor approved the budget?
(A) He's been out of the office all week.
(B) The budget meeting is upstairs.
(C) Yes, I know him quite well.

items.ex: 승인 여부를 묻자 '그가 일주일 내내 자리에 없었다'며 아직 승인 안 됐을 가능성을 암시했다. Do you know에 '그를 잘 안다'로 답하는 보기는 대표적 함정.

say.t: Let's ask the vendor for a discount on the bulk order.
(A) Two boxes of printer paper.
(B) They've already given us their lowest price.
(C) In alphabetical order, please.

items.ex: 할인 요청 제안에 '이미 최저가를 줬다'며 소용없음을 알렸다. order(순서) 반복은 다의어 함정.

say.t: How did the online booking system work out for the clinic?
(A) By next Thursday at the latest.
(B) I usually work out after work.
(C) Patients have stopped calling to make appointments.

items.ex: 성과를 묻자 '전화 예약이 사라졌다'로 성공을 간접적으로 전했다. work out(운동하다)은 다의어 함정.

say.t: Who should I contact about the broken projector?
(A) Isn't there a request form on the intranet?
(B) The company projects higher profits.
(C) Yes, it's been broken since Monday.

items.ex: 누구에게 연락할지 묻자 '인트라넷 신청서가 있지 않나요?'라고 되물어 절차를 알려 줬다. project(예상하다)는 소리 함정, 의문사 의문문에 Yes는 오답.

say.t: Haven't the new recycling bins been delivered yet?
(A) Every Tuesday morning.
(B) We recycled most of the paper.
(C) I'll check with the front desk.

items.ex: 배송 여부를 묻자 '프런트에 확인해 보겠다'는 전형적 확인형 응답. recycle 반복은 소리 함정.

say.t: Why was the product launch moved to March?
(A) Yes, in early March.
(B) I moved to a new apartment.
(C) The supplier couldn't ship the parts in time.

items.ex: 연기 이유를 묻자 '부품 공급 지연'이라는 이유를 댔다. moved·March 반복 보기와 Yes 응답은 함정.

say.t: Can I scan the QR code at the entrance, or do I need a printed ticket?
(A) Yes, the entrance is on the left.
(B) The code on your phone works fine.
(C) I printed it in color.

items.ex: 선택의문문에 '휴대폰 코드로 충분하다'며 QR 쪽을 택했다. entrance·printed 반복은 소리 함정.

say.t: Our quarterly sales were higher than projected.
(A) The new loyalty program must be paying off.
(B) Every quarter of an hour.
(C) The projector's been repaired.

items.ex: 매출 호조 소식에 '새 멤버십 프로그램 효과인가 보다'라고 반응했다. projected–projector, quarterly–quarter는 소리 함정.

say.t: Where are we holding the retirement dinner?
(A) She's retiring in May.
(B) Daniel's in charge of the arrangements.
(C) Right after the awards.

items.ex: 장소를 묻자 '다니엘이 준비 담당'이라며 아는 사람을 알려 주는 간접 응답. retire 반복과 시점 응답은 함정.

say.t: Shouldn't we hire a temporary worker for the busy season?
(A) It's been a busy morning.
(B) He works at the front desk.
(C) The budget won't allow it this year.

items.ex: 임시직 채용 제안에 '올해 예산이 안 된다'며 반대했다. busy 반복은 소리 함정.

say.t: Are the hybrid work guidelines finalized, or is HR still revising them?
(A) They're being sent out this afternoon.
(B) Yes, the final round.
(C) I work from home twice a week.

items.ex: '오늘 오후 배포된다'는 말로 확정되었음을 간접적으로 알렸다. work·final 반복과 선택의문문의 Yes는 함정.

say.t: I'd like to return this coffee maker I ordered online.
(A) Black, no sugar, please.
(B) Do you have the receipt with you?
(C) It returns to the schedule next month.

items.ex: 반품 요청에 '영수증 있으세요?'라고 되물으며 절차를 진행했다. coffee에서 연상한 주문 응답은 함정.

say.t: When will the AI chatbot be added to the customer service page?
(A) The page has three sections.
(B) It's still in the testing phase.
(C) Customers can leave a comment.

items.ex: 추가 시점을 묻자 '아직 테스트 단계'라며 미정임을 알렸다. customer·page 반복은 소리 함정.

parts.name: Part 3
parts.dir: PART 3 지시문: 두 사람 이상이 나누는 대화를 듣게 됩니다. 각 대화를 듣고 그에 관한 세 개의 질문에 답하세요. 가장 알맞은 답을 고르세요. 대화는 한 번만 들려주며 시험지에 인쇄되어 있지 않습니다.

script.t: Hi, this is Mariela Duarte from Brightline Analytics on the sixth floor. I'm calling because the chargers in the underground garage won't accept my access card anymore.
Sorry about that. We switched to a new payment system over the weekend, so all the old cards were deactivated.
Oh, nobody let us know. I'm parked at one of the chargers right now, and my battery's almost empty. I've got a client meeting in Westbrook at two.
I understand. The quickest fix is to download the ParkPoint app and link it to your company account. Then you just scan the code on the charger.
OK. Will the charging be billed to my firm, or do I have to pay for it myself?
As long as you register with your work e-mail address, it goes straight onto your company's monthly invoice.
Great. I'll do that right now, then. Thanks.

qs.q: Why is the woman calling?
o: A charging station has been physically damaged.
A client meeting has been moved.
Something she uses to pay has stopped working.
A parking space she reserved is occupied.
qs.ex: 카드가 더 이상 인식되지 않는다는 내용을 '결제 수단이 작동을 멈췄다'로 바꿔 말했다. 회의 장소가 언급되지만 일정이 바뀐 것은 아니다.

qs.q: What does the man say happened over the weekend?
o: A new payment method was introduced.
The garage was closed for repairs.
qs.ex: switched to a new payment system을 '새 결제 방식 도입'으로 패러프레이즈했다. 충전기를 추가 설치했다는 말은 없다.

qs.q: What does the woman ask about?
o: Where she can download an app
qs.ex: 회사로 청구되는지 본인이 내는지 물었으므로 '비용 부담 주체'가 정답. 앱은 남자가 먼저 언급한 것이라 함정.

script.t: Natalie, are you coming into the office on Tuesday? I was hoping to go over the vendor proposals together in person.
I was planning to, but I haven't reserved a desk yet. Have you used the new booking system?
Yeah, the one on the intranet. You have to book by noon the day before. Otherwise your spot gets released to someone else.
Hmm. The third floor's been packed every Tuesday since the policy changed.
That's true. Well, what about Wednesday? The project room on the fifth floor is almost always free, and it has a big screen for comparing the bids.
Wednesday works. I'll just have to push my call with the Lisbon office to the afternoon.
Perfect. I'll reserve the room and send you a calendar invitation.

qs.q: What does the man want to do?
o: Sign a contract with a vendor
qs.ex: go over the vendor proposals together in person을 '제안서를 대면으로 논의'로 바꿨다. vendor가 나온다고 계약 서명을 고르면 함정.

qs.q: Why does the woman say, "The third floor's been packed every Tuesday since the policy changed"?
o: To suggest moving to a different team
To express doubt that a desk will be available
To explain why she prefers working remotely
To complain about noise in the office
qs.ex: 화요일엔 늘 자리가 꽉 찬다는 말로 예약해도 자리가 없을 수 있다는 우려를 표했다. 소음 불만이나 재택 선호는 언급되지 않았다.

qs.q: What will the man most likely do next?
qs.ex: I'll reserve the room이 '회의 공간 예약'으로 바뀌었다. 리스본 지사 통화 일정은 여자가 옮길 일이라 함정.

script.t: Thank you for calling Greenbasket Meals. This is Owen speaking. How can I help you?
Hi. I've been getting your weekly meal kits for about a year, but I'll be traveling for work most of next month. Is there a way to stop deliveries without closing my account?
Certainly. You can pause your plan for up to six weeks. May I have the name on the account?
Sure, it's Kendra Farrow.
Thanks, Ms. Farrow. I see your next box is scheduled for Thursday. Unfortunately, that one's already been packed, so the pause would start the week after.
That's fine. I'm not leaving until Saturday anyway.
Great. And since you've been with us for over a year, you're eligible for a free dessert add-on once your deliveries resume.
Oh, that's nice. Thanks for letting me know.

qs.q: Why is the woman calling?
qs.ex: 계정은 유지하고 배송만 멈추고 싶다고 했으므로 '서비스 일시 중지'가 정답. 해지(closing my account)와 구별해야 한다.

qs.q: What does the man say about Thursday's order?
o: It includes a new menu item.
It will arrive a day late.
It is already prepared for shipment.
It can be picked up at a store.
qs.ex: already been packed를 '이미 발송 준비가 끝났다'로 바꿨다. 배송 지연 이야기는 없다.

qs.q: What will the woman receive?
qs.ex: free dessert add-on을 '무료 품목'으로 패러프레이즈했다. travel은 여자의 출장 사정일 뿐이라 함정.

script.t: Thanks for joining us, Rafael. Since you'll be supervising the packing line starting Monday, Dmitri and I wanted to walk you through some changes.
Sure. I heard something about new packaging materials?
Right. Starting next month, we're replacing all the plastic air pillows with paper-based filler. A lot of our retail clients have been asking for it.
Makes sense. Won't that slow the packers down, though? Paper can be tricky to handle.
That was our concern, too. So the supplier is installing a machine that crumples and dispenses the paper automatically.
It'll go in at stations one through four first. If that goes smoothly, we'll add it to the rest of the line.
OK. Should I set up some training for the team?
Yes. The supplier's technician will be here on the fourteenth. Could you arrange for everyone on the morning shift to attend?
I'll put a schedule together today.

qs.q: Who most likely is Rafael?
qs.ex: 다음 주 월요일부터 포장 라인을 감독할 사람이므로 새로 배치된 관리자다. technician은 공급업체 측 인물이라 함정.

qs.q: Why is the company changing its packaging materials?
o: To comply with a new regulation
qs.ex: retail clients have been asking for it이 '고객 요청'으로 바뀌었다. 비용·규정 이야기는 없다.

qs.q: What does the woman ask Rafael to do?
o: Organize a training session for staff
qs.ex: 오전 근무조 전원이 기술자 교육에 참석하도록 일정을 잡아 달라고 했다. 기계 설치는 공급업체가 하므로 함정.

script.t: Hey Sam, have you looked at the numbers from our first month of QR ordering?
I have. The average order went up about fifteen percent, mostly because the menu suggests add-ons like pastries.
That's great. But a few of our regulars told me they found it confusing, especially some of our older guests.
I've heard that, too. Maybe we could keep a couple of printed menus at the counter for anyone who'd rather order in person.
Good idea. And what if we put a short how-to card on each table? Just three simple steps with pictures.
I can design that. My cousin's a graphic designer, so I'll have her look it over before we print anything.
Perfect. Let's aim to have them on the tables by next Monday.

qs.q: According to the man, what has increased?
o: The amount customers spend per order
qs.ex: average order went up을 '주문당 지출 금액 증가'로 바꿨다. regulars는 불만을 말한 손님으로 나왔을 뿐 늘었다는 말은 없다.

qs.q: What concern does the woman mention?
o: Some customers have had trouble using a system.
The tables are too close together.
qs.ex: found it confusing을 '시스템 사용에 어려움'으로 패러프레이즈했다. 인쇄 메뉴는 해결책으로 나온 것이지 비용 문제가 아니다.

qs.q: What does the man say he will do?
qs.ex: how-to card를 직접 디자인하겠다고 했으므로 '안내문 제작'이 정답. 사촌은 검토만 해 주므로 '디자이너 고용'은 함정.

script.t: Hi, Joanna. Did you get a chance to try the AI writing assistant on the product catalog?
I did. I used it for the kitchenware section, and it produced descriptions for all two hundred items in about an hour.
Wow, that would normally take the team a week. So we can publish them on the site tomorrow?
Well, the client signs off on everything.
Right, of course. How long does their review usually take?
About three business days. But I noticed the tool exaggerated a few product features, so I'd like Marcus to double-check the measurements first.
Good thinking. I'll let the client know the files will reach them on Thursday instead.

qs.q: What does the woman say about the AI tool?
qs.ex: 200개 설명을 한 시간 만에 만들었다는 말을 '작업을 빨리 끝냈다'로 바꿨다. 비용·학습 난이도는 언급되지 않았다.

qs.q: What does the woman imply when she says, "Well, the client signs off on everything"?
o: She wants the man to call the client.
The client is pleased with the tool.
The descriptions cannot be posted yet.
qs.ex: 고객 승인이 먼저라는 말로 내일 바로 게시할 수 없다는 뜻을 전했다. 이어서 남자가 검토 기간을 묻는 흐름이 단서.

qs.q: Why does the woman want Marcus to check the files?
o: The client requested a different format.
Some product information may be inaccurate.
qs.ex: 도구가 기능을 과장했다(exaggerated)는 것을 '정보가 부정확할 수 있다'로 바꿨다. 마감이 지났다는 말은 없다.

script.t: Good morning, Harborview Hotel events office. This is Lucy.
Hi, Lucy. This is Vikram Shah from Telford Engineering. We've booked the Maple Room for our sales training on the twentieth.
Yes, I have your reservation right here. Thirty participants, with lunch.
Actually, that's why I'm calling. We've had more sign-ups than we expected, so we're now up to forty-five people.
I see. The Maple Room only holds thirty-five. But Cedar Hall is open that day, and it seats up to sixty.
Is there a difference in price?
It's a little more. But since you're a returning customer, I can waive the fee for the audiovisual equipment.
That sounds good. Please go ahead and switch us.
Certainly. I'll e-mail you an updated contract within the hour.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the man's call?
o: To register for a training course
qs.ex: 참가 인원이 늘어 예약을 바꾸려는 전화다. 점심은 기존 예약 내용일 뿐 취소한다는 말은 없다.

qs.q: What does the woman offer to do?
o: Extend the event by a day
qs.ex: waive the fee for the audiovisual equipment를 '장비 요금 면제'로 바꿨다. lunch는 대화에 나온 단어를 이용한 함정.

qs.q: What will the woman send the man?
qs.ex: updated contract가 '수정된 계약서(agreement)'로 패러프레이즈되었다. 참가자 명단은 남자 쪽 정보라 함정.

script.t: So, as you know, with most of our staff working remotely three days a week, we really don't need this much floor space anymore.
Right. Grace and I went through your occupancy data. On a typical day, only about sixty percent of the desks are in use.
So for the new layout, we're proposing fewer assigned desks and more small rooms where people can take video calls.
That's exactly what our employees have been asking for. The rooms we have now are always booked.
We also added a lounge area by the windows. It can serve as a casual workspace or be cleared out for company events.
I like that. What about the timeline? Our lease here runs out in April.
If you approve the plan this week, construction could begin in early February.
Let me run it by our directors first. I'll get back to you by Friday.

qs.q: Why is the man's company changing its office space?
o: Its employees spend less time on-site.
It is merging with another firm.
qs.ex: 직원들이 주 3일 원격 근무해서 공간이 덜 필요하다는 말을 '사무실에 머무는 시간이 줄었다'로 바꿨다. 임대료 인상은 언급되지 않았다.

qs.q: What do the women propose adding?
qs.ex: video calls용 작은 방을 '온라인 회의용 공간'으로 패러프레이즈했다. 고정 좌석은 오히려 줄인다고 했으므로 반대 함정.

qs.q: What does the man say he will do?
qs.ex: run it by our directors를 '임원진과 상의'로 바꿨다. lease는 4월 만료 이야기에 나온 단어를 이용한 함정.

script.t: Hi, I have a reservation under Callahan. A midsize car for three days.
Welcome, Mr. Callahan. Just so you know, we upgraded our fleet this month, so all our midsize cars are now electric.
Oh, I've never driven an electric car before. I'm heading up to the lake district, and I'm not sure there are many chargers out there.
Actually, there's a fast-charging station at every rest stop along Highway 12. And the navigation system will point you to the nearest one automatically.
That's a relief. Do I need to bring it back fully charged?
No, just above twenty percent. Below that, there's a small recharging fee.
Got it. And how do I pay at the stations?
The card in the glove compartment covers it. Everything's billed to your rental.

qs.q: What does the woman say happened this month?
qs.ex: upgraded our fleet를 '보유 차량이 교체되었다'로 바꿨다. 요금 인상 이야기는 없다.

qs.q: What is the man concerned about?
o: How long the drive will take
The total cost of the rental
qs.ex: 그 지역에 충전기가 많지 않을까 걱정했다. midsize는 차종 정보일 뿐 크기를 걱정한 것은 아니다.

qs.q: According to the woman, when would the man pay an additional fee?
o: If he returns the car late
If he loses a payment card
If the battery is too low when he returns the car
If he drives on certain highways
qs.ex: 20% 미만으로 반납하면 충전 수수료가 붙는다고 했다. 카드는 충전 결제용으로만 언급되었다.

script.t: Theo, I just heard from our audio production team. They'd like to record the audiobook version of your novel next month.
That's great news. Will they be hiring a professional narrator?
They were going to, but our reader survey showed a lot of people would rather hear the author. Would you be willing to read it yourself?
I'd love to, but I'm not sure my voice will hold up that long. The book's over four hundred pages.
Don't worry. The sessions are only three hours a day, and the studio is just two blocks from your apartment.
In that case, count me in. When would we start?
The producer will call you this week to set the dates. She'll also send you some tips on how to prepare.

qs.q: What does the woman say about a survey?
o: The book cover should be redesigned.
Sales have been lower than expected.
Readers would like the author to narrate.
qs.ex: 작가가 직접 읽기를 원한다는 독자 설문 결과를 그대로 바꿔 말했다. 판매 부진은 언급되지 않았다.

qs.q: What is the man concerned about?
o: Whether he can read aloud for long periods
How much he will be paid
The length of the production schedule
qs.ex: 목소리가 오래 버틸지 걱정했다. 스튜디오 위치는 여자가 안심시키며 꺼낸 정보라 함정.

qs.q: What will the producer do?
o: Contact the man to arrange a schedule
qs.ex: 이번 주에 전화해 날짜를 정한다고 했다. 전문 성우 고용은 원래 계획이었다가 바뀐 것이라 함정.

script.t: Welcome to Northgate Workhub. Are you interested in a membership?
Yes. My company just gave up its office and went fully remote, but our three-person design team wants somewhere to meet twice a week.
Then you probably don't need a private office. Each of them could get our Flex plan. That's ten days a month.
Hmm, twice a week comes to about eight or nine days, so that would work. Do the plans include meeting rooms?
Every member gets four hours of meeting room time a month, and you can book it through our app.
Great. Is there any discount for signing up several people?
Yes. For three or more members from the same company, we take ten percent off.
OK. Let me check with my manager, and I'll come back tomorrow.

qs.q: What does the woman say about her company?
o: It is looking for an event venue.
It is relocating to another city.
It no longer has a permanent office.
qs.ex: gave up its office and went fully remote를 '상설 사무실이 더 이상 없다'로 바꿨다. 디자인팀 3명은 기존 인원이지 신규 채용이 아니다.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. What is the regular monthly price of the plan the man recommends for each person?
qs.ex: 남자는 월 10일 이용인 Flex 플랜을 추천했으므로 표에서 $240. 10% 할인은 '정가'를 묻는 질문과 무관하며, 남자가 필요 없다고 한 개인 사무실 가격은 함정.

qs.q: What will the woman most likely do next?
qs.ex: check with my manager를 '상사와 이야기하다'로 패러프레이즈했다. 앱은 회의실 예약 방법으로만 언급되었다.

script.t: Kirsten, are you going to any of the training sessions on Thursday?
Yes, I signed up for the data privacy one. Our whole department has to complete it before next month's audit.
I was going to take the AI report builder session, but I have a vendor call at ten thirty that I can't move.
Isn't that one being recorded? I thought they said all the sessions would be posted on the training portal.
Not that one. It's hands-on, so they're not recording it. I guess I'll go to the dashboard session instead. It covers a lot of the same features.
Then we'll both be there in the afternoon. Want to grab a coffee in between?
Sure. I'll meet you in the lobby after mine.

items.graphic:

qs.q: Why must the woman's department attend a session?
o: To prepare for an upcoming review
qs.ex: audit(감사)를 '다가오는 점검(review)'으로 바꿨다. 고객 요청이라는 말은 없다.

qs.q: What does the woman ask about?
o: Whether a session will be recorded
qs.ex: 그 세션도 녹화되지 않느냐고 물었다. training portal이 언급되지만 등록 방법을 물은 것은 아니다.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. What time will the man's session begin?
qs.ex: 남자는 대시보드 세션으로 바꾼다고 했으므로 표에서 1:00. 10:30은 원래 듣고 싶었던 AI 세션 시간이라 함정.

script.t: Andre, have you looked at the forecast for our e-bike demonstration day?
I have. Thursday's going to be sunny, but the wind looks really strong. Our tents won't hold up in gusts like that.
And Friday's out anyway. The park's closed for maintenance that day.
Right. Sunday's supposed to be rainy, too, and nobody wants to test-ride a bike on wet roads.
So that leaves us one option. Honestly, a cloudy day might even be better. People won't overheat while they're riding.
Agreed. I'll call the rental company and change the delivery date for the tents.
Great. And I'll update the event page so everyone who registered online gets a notification.

qs.q: What are the speakers planning?
o: An opportunity to try out products
qs.ex: e-bike demonstration day에서 시승(test-ride)을 한다고 했으므로 '제품 체험 행사'가 정답. 자전거가 나온다고 경주를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. What will the high temperature most likely be on the day of the event?
qs.ex: 목요일은 강풍, 금요일은 공원 휴무, 일요일은 비로 제외되어 흐린 토요일이 남는다. 표에서 토요일 최고기온은 21°C.

qs.q: What will the woman do?
qs.ex: 행사 페이지를 수정해 등록자에게 알림이 가게 하겠다고 했다. 대여 업체 연락은 남자가 할 일이라 함정.

parts.name: Part 4
parts.dir: PART 4 지시문: 한 사람이 말하는 짧은 담화를 듣게 됩니다. 각 담화를 듣고 그에 관한 세 개의 질문에 답하세요. 가장 알맞은 답을 고르세요. 담화는 한 번만 들려주며 시험지에 인쇄되어 있지 않습니다.

script.t: Hi, this message is for Mr. Adebayo. This is Clara from Linwood Home Furnishings, calling about the dining table and chairs you ordered last week. Our truck was scheduled to bring them to you this Friday morning. However, as part of our new low-emission delivery program, we've combined routes in your area, and your neighborhood is now served on Saturdays only. I'm sorry for the short notice. To thank you for your patience, we'll assemble the table at no charge, a service that normally costs forty dollars. Please confirm a two-hour delivery window using the link we just texted to your phone. If Saturday doesn't work for you, you can also pick up your order at our Hollis Road warehouse any weekday until seven p.m. Thanks, and have a good day.

qs.q: Why has a delivery date been changed?
o: A delivery truck has broken down.
An item is temporarily out of stock.
qs.ex: 저탄소 배송 프로그램으로 경로를 통합했다는 말을 '배송 경로 재편'으로 바꿨다. 재고 부족이나 차량 고장은 언급되지 않았다.

qs.q: What does the speaker offer the listener?
qs.ex: 보통 40달러인 조립을 무료로 해 준다고 했다. chairs는 주문 품목일 뿐 할인 대상이 아니다.

qs.q: What is the listener asked to do?
qs.ex: 문자로 받은 링크에서 두 시간 배송 시간대를 확정해 달라고 했다. 창고 방문은 선택 사항이라 함정.

script.t: Good morning, everyone. Before we start today's staff meeting, I'd like to mention a change to how we handle meeting notes. Starting next Monday, our video-conferencing platform will automatically produce a written summary after every call, including a list of action items and who's responsible for each one. The summaries will be saved to the project folder within ten minutes of the call ending. Now, I know some of you have doubts about accuracy. Well, the pilot group in accounting tested it for two months. They reported that it caught nearly every assignment. That said, whoever organizes a meeting should still read the summary and correct any errors before sharing it. Ellen from IT will run a fifteen-minute demonstration right after this meeting, so please stay if you can.

qs.q: What is the speaker mainly discussing?
o: A training program for new hires
qs.ex: 통화 후 요약문을 자동 생성하는 기능을 '자동 기록 기능'으로 바꿨다. project folder는 저장 위치일 뿐 새 시스템이 아니다.

qs.q: Why does the speaker say, "the pilot group in accounting tested it for two months"?
o: To explain why a project was delayed
To reassure listeners about a tool's reliability
To ask for volunteers for a trial
To praise a department's financial results
qs.ex: 정확도를 걱정하는 직원들에게 두 달간 시험해 거의 다 잡아냈다는 근거를 들어 안심시킨 것이다. accounting에서 재무 실적을 연상하면 함정.

qs.q: What are meeting organizers asked to do?
o: Attend a session in the accounting department
qs.ex: 회의 주최자는 요약문을 읽고 오류를 고친 뒤 공유하라고 했다. action items는 요약에 포함되는 내용이라 함정.

script.t: In local news, the city of Fairmont announced yesterday that it will install electric-vehicle chargers at all seven public library branches by the end of the year. The project is being funded by a regional clean-transportation grant, so it won't add to local taxes. City planners say libraries were chosen because visitors usually stay for an hour or more, which is roughly how long a car needs to gain a meaningful charge. Drivers will be able to reserve a charger in advance through the city's parking app. The first stations will open at the Riverside branch next month, and officials are inviting residents to an information session there on the fifteenth to learn how the reservation system works. Coming up after the break, we'll have an update on weekend traffic.

qs.q: How is the project being paid for?
qs.ex: 지역 친환경 교통 보조금으로 충당된다고 했다. 세금은 '늘지 않는다'고 했으므로 반대 함정.

qs.q: According to city planners, why were libraries selected?
o: They are open late at night.
Visitors tend to stay there for a while.
qs.ex: 방문객이 한 시간 이상 머문다는 이유를 '한동안 머무는 경향'으로 바꿨다. 주차장 규모는 언급되지 않았다.

qs.q: What will happen on the fifteenth?
o: An informational gathering will be held.
A road will be closed to traffic.
A parking app will be launched.
qs.ex: 15일에 예약 시스템 설명회가 열린다. 주차 앱은 이미 있는 것이고, traffic은 다음 순서 예고에 나온 단어라 함정.

script.t: Welcome to Ridgeline Cycles. I'm Bruno, and I'll be guiding you through our assembly plant this morning. Before we start, please make sure you're wearing the safety glasses we handed out at the entrance. The tour takes about an hour. We'll begin in the frame workshop, where every frame is still welded by hand. Then we'll move on to the paint area, where we switched to water-based coatings last year to cut emissions. Now, you may have noticed there aren't any lunch tables in the visitor area. The café across the parking lot opens at eleven. Finally, we'll finish in the testing room, where you'll be able to ride one of our new cargo bikes on an indoor track. Photos are welcome everywhere except the paint area, since camera flashes can affect the drying process.

qs.q: What are listeners asked to do before the tour begins?
o: Leave their bags at the entrance
qs.ex: safety glasses를 '보호 안경'으로 바꿨다. entrance는 안경을 나눠 준 장소일 뿐 가방을 맡기라는 말은 없다.

qs.q: Why does the speaker say, "The café across the parking lot opens at eleven"?
o: To announce a change to the tour route
To suggest where listeners can get a meal
To explain why the tour will be delayed
qs.ex: 방문자 구역에 점심 테이블이 없다고 한 직후의 말이므로 식사할 곳을 알려 주는 의도다. 투어 지연과는 관계가 없다.

qs.q: Where are listeners NOT allowed to take photographs?
qs.ex: 페인트 구역(paint area)을 '코팅을 칠하는 곳'으로 패러프레이즈했다. 실내 트랙이 있는 테스트실은 촬영 가능.

script.t: Do the plants in your office look tired? With Leafline's monthly plant-care subscription, they don't have to. For one flat fee, our horticulturists will visit your workplace every two weeks to water, trim, and feed your plants. If any plant doesn't survive, we'll replace it free of charge. And unlike other services, Leafline gives you an online dashboard where you can see each plant's health record and request extra visits with a single click. Businesses that sign up before the end of this month will get their first month free, plus a set of self-watering pots for their reception area. Visit leafline-care dot com to book a consultation, and one of our specialists will recommend the best plants for the lighting conditions in your space.

qs.q: What is being advertised?
o: A maintenance service for indoor greenery
qs.ex: 사무실 식물을 정기 방문해 관리해 주는 구독 서비스다. plant에서 꽃 배달을 연상하면 함정.

qs.q: What does the speaker say makes Leafline different from other services?
o: It provides an online tracking tool.
qs.ex: unlike other services 뒤에 나온 온라인 대시보드가 차별점이다. 요금은 정액제(flat fee)라 방문당 요금은 반대 함정.

qs.q: According to the advertisement, what will businesses that sign up this month receive in addition to a free month?
qs.ex: self-watering pots를 '식물 용기'로 바꿨다. 교체 식물은 식물이 죽었을 때 제공되는 기본 서비스라 함정.

script.t: Thanks for coming, everyone. As you know, since we adopted a hybrid schedule last spring, each team has chosen its own office days. The downside is that cross-team projects have been hard to coordinate. People from marketing and product rarely seem to be here at the same time. So, beginning in November, Tuesdays and Thursdays will be company-wide office days. The other three weekdays will stay flexible. I realize this may affect some of your commutes, so we're expanding the shuttle service from Grandview Station to run every twenty minutes on those two days. The cafeteria will also offer a free breakfast on Tuesdays to make the transition a little easier. If you have circumstances that make these days difficult, please talk to your manager before the end of the month.

qs.q: What problem does the speaker mention?
o: The office has become too crowded.
A product launch is behind schedule.
qs.ex: 팀 간 프로젝트 조율이 어렵다는 말을 '부서 간 협업 어려움'으로 바꿨다. product는 부서 이름일 뿐 출시 지연과 무관하다.

qs.q: What will the company expand?
qs.ex: Grandview역 셔틀을 20분 간격으로 늘린다고 했다. 카페테리아는 무료 아침 제공이지 확장이 아니다.

qs.q: What should listeners with scheduling difficulties do?
qs.ex: talk to your manager를 '상사와 이야기하다'로 바꿨다. 인사팀이나 온라인 양식은 언급되지 않았다.

script.t: Attention, passengers waiting for the nine-fifteen express to Port Ellery. Due to a signal fault near Calder Junction, this service is now expected to depart approximately forty minutes late. If you have a connection at Port Ellery, the regional line there will hold its ten-fifty departure for passengers from this train. Passengers who'd prefer an alternative may take the nine-thirty local service from platform six, which is running on time. Please note that it makes eleven stops. Your current ticket is valid on that train, so there's no need to exchange it. Also, anyone delayed by more than thirty minutes may claim a partial refund by scanning the QR code on the posters around the station. We apologize for the disruption and thank you for your patience.

qs.q: What has caused the delay?
qs.ex: signal fault(신호 장애)를 '장비 고장'으로 바꿨다. 선로 공사나 날씨는 언급되지 않았다.

qs.q: What does the speaker imply when he says, "it makes eleven stops"?
o: The train will be very crowded.
The alternative train may not arrive any sooner.
qs.ex: 정시 출발하는 완행이지만 정차역이 많아 결국 더 빨리 도착하지 않을 수 있음을 암시했다. 표는 그대로 유효하다고 했으므로 업그레이드는 함정.

qs.q: How can passengers request compensation?
o: By showing a ticket to a conductor
qs.ex: 역 안 포스터의 QR 코드를 스캔해 일부 환불을 신청하라고 했다. 매표소 방문은 언급되지 않았다.

script.t: Good evening, and welcome to the Hartwell Business Association's annual awards dinner. Our first award tonight, Small Business of the Year, goes to Copperleaf Logistics. When founder Amira Haddad started the company five years ago, she had just two vans and a single warehouse. Today, Copperleaf delivers to more than three hundred local shops, and last year it became the first courier in our region to run an entirely electric fleet. What impressed our judges most, however, wasn't the company's growth. It was Ms. Haddad's apprenticeship program, which has trained over forty young drivers and warehouse technicians from our community. Ms. Haddad will say a few words in a moment, but first, let's watch a short video her team put together about the company's journey. Could we dim the lights, please?

qs.q: According to the speaker, what was Copperleaf Logistics the first in the region to do?
qs.ex: entirely electric fleet를 '전기차만 운영'으로 바꿨다. 40명은 견습 프로그램 수료 인원이지 '최초' 항목이 아니다.

qs.q: What impressed the judges most?
qs.ex: 성장이 아니라 견습(apprenticeship) 프로그램이라고 했으므로 '직업 훈련 프로그램'. 빠른 성장은 명시적으로 부정된 함정.

qs.q: What will the listeners do next?
o: Hear a speech by Ms. Haddad
qs.ex: 조명을 낮추고 짧은 영상을 먼저 본다고 했다. 수상 소감은 영상 다음 순서라 함정.

script.t: Let's move on to our subscriber numbers for September. As you can see, the Standard plan is still our most popular, which isn't surprising, since it's the one we feature in most of our ads. What I want to focus on, though, is the plan with the fewest subscribers. Our survey showed that customers think it's too expensive for what it offers. So, starting next month, we'll add offline downloads and a second simultaneous screen to that plan, without changing the price. We expect this to double its subscriber count by spring. Of course, we need to get the word out. I'd like the design team to create a short video ad highlighting these new features. Please have a first draft ready for review by next Wednesday.

qs.q: What does the speaker say about the Standard plan?
o: Its price will increase next month.
It is promoted heavily in advertising.
qs.ex: the one we feature in most of our ads를 '광고에서 집중적으로 홍보된다'로 바꿨다. 가격 인상은 없다고 했다.

qs.q: Look at the graphic. Which plan will be updated?
qs.ex: 가입자가 가장 적은 플랜을 개선한다고 했으므로 표에서 2,100명인 Premium. 가장 인기 있는 Standard는 함정.

qs.q: What does the speaker ask the design team to do?
qs.ex: 새 기능을 알리는 짧은 영상 광고 초안을 요청했다. 설문은 이미 실시된 것이라 함정.

script.t: Good morning, Expo attendees. I have a few updates about today's sessions. First, the speaker for the eleven-thirty session on AI warehousing has been delayed by a flight cancellation. He has kindly agreed to swap time slots with our final speaker of the day, who'll now give the software demonstration at eleven thirty instead. Both sessions will stay in their original halls. Second, because so many of you have registered for this afternoon's packaging session, it has been moved from Hall A to the main auditorium on the ground floor. Finally, remember that the Expo app now has a live seat counter, so you can check availability before walking over. And anyone who completes the feedback survey in the app will be entered into a drawing for a free pass to next year's Expo.

parts.name: Part 5
parts.dir: 문장의 빈칸(-------)에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 단어나 어구를 (A)~(D) 중에서 고르세요.

items.q: ------- the quarterly figures had been finalized, the finance team began drafting the investor presentation.
items.ex: 빈칸 뒤에 주어+동사(the figures had been finalized)가 있는 절이 오므로 접속사 Once(일단 ~하자)가 정답. During·Because of·Despite는 전치사(구)라 절을 이끌 수 없다.

items.q: Had the vendor ------- the shipment on time, the product launch would not have been postponed.
items.ex: If가 생략된 가정법 과거완료 도치(Had+주어+p.p.)이므로 delivered. 뒤에 목적어 the shipment가 있으니 수동형 been delivered는 함정.

items.q: ------- by the positive response to its pilot program, Corvella Foods plans to offer its meal-kit subscription nationwide.
items.ex: 주어 Corvella Foods가 반응에 의해 '고무된' 것이므로 수동 분사구문 Encouraged. 뒤에 by가 있으므로 능동 Encouraging은 오답.

items.q: Employees may work remotely up to three days a week ------- they remain available during the core hours of 10 A.M. to 3 P.M.
items.ex: '~라는 조건으로'의 뜻으로 절을 이끄는 접속사 provided that이 정답. in case of·regardless of는 명사를, so as to는 동사원형을 받는다.

items.q: Neither the regional managers nor the director ------- aware that the software license had expired.
items.ex: neither A nor B는 B(the director, 단수)에 수를 일치시키고, 과거완료 had expired와 시제도 맞아 was. 앞의 managers만 보고 were를 고르면 함정.

items.q: The new AI scheduling assistant has significantly reduced the time staff spend ------- meeting rooms.
items.ex: spend+시간+-ing(~하는 데 시간을 쓰다) 구문이므로 reserving. spend 뒤에는 to부정사 to reserve를 쓰지 않는다.

items.q: The board approved the merger ------- concerns raised by several shareholders about the valuation.
items.ex: 빈칸 뒤가 명사구(concerns raised by ...)이므로 전치사 notwithstanding(~에도 불구하고). although·whereas·unless는 접속사라 절이 와야 한다.

items.q: Ms. Halvorsen's proposal was ------- the most comprehensive of all the submissions the committee received.
items.ex: 최상급(the most comprehensive)을 강조할 때는 by far를 쓴다. very는 the very best처럼 the 뒤에 와야 하고, so much·too는 최상급을 수식하지 않는다.

items.q: Applicants are required to submit a portfolio ------- with two letters of recommendation.
items.ex: along with(~와 함께)가 짝을 이루는 표현. besides·except는 with와 결합해 쓰지 않는다.

items.q: It is essential that every driver ------- the vehicle's charge level before leaving the depot.
items.ex: essential that 뒤에는 당위의 (should) 동사원형이 오므로 check. 주어 every driver가 단수라 checks를 고르면 함정.

items.q: The marketing department has been allocated a budget ------- to cover both the trade show and the online campaign.
items.ex: 명사 budget을 뒤에서 꾸미는 형용사 자리(sufficient to do: ~하기에 충분한). sufficiently는 부사라 명사를 수식할 수 없다.

items.q: Customers who wish to ------- their subscription may do so at any time through the account settings page.
items.ex: 구독을 '중단하다'는 discontinue. refrain·abstain은 자동사라 from이 필요하고, resign은 직책에서 물러날 때 쓴다.

items.q: Only after the safety inspection was completed ------- the warehouse reopen to staff.
items.ex: Only after ~가 문두에 오면 주절이 도치되며, 동사원형 reopen과 과거 시제(was completed)에 맞는 조동사는 did. does는 시제가 맞지 않는다.

items.q: The revised reimbursement policy will go into ------- at the start of the next fiscal year.
items.ex: go into effect(시행되다)는 고정 연어. 'put into practice(실행에 옮기다)'와 혼동하기 쉬운 함정.

items.q: ------- the final chapter of the training manual, all sections have been translated into Spanish.
items.ex: 명사구 앞에서 '~을 제외하고'를 뜻하는 전치사구 With the exception of가 정답. Except that은 절을 이끌고, In addition to는 의미가 맞지 않는다.

items.q: Visitors are asked to scan the QR code at the entrance so that their attendance can be recorded -------.
items.ex: 수동태 동사 can be recorded를 수식하는 부사 accurately. 형용사 accurate·more accurate는 동사를 꾸밀 수 없다.

items.q: The CEO, ------- leadership the firm doubled its revenue, will retire at the end of the year.
items.ex: '그의 지도 아래(under his leadership)'가 관계사절로 바뀐 형태이므로 under whose. whose만 쓰면 the firm doubled its revenue가 완전한 절이라 leadership이 들어갈 자리가 없다.

items.q: Ms. Okafor has been appointed regional director, ------- Mr. Grant, who is relocating to the Singapore office.
items.ex: Ms. Okafor가 Mr. Grant의 뒤를 '잇는' 능동 관계이고 뒤에 목적어가 있으므로 현재분사 succeeding. succeeded는 수동 의미가 되어 오답.

items.q: The updated scheduling software is fully ------- with all tablets purchased after 2022.
items.ex: 기기와 '호환되는'은 compatible with. comparable(비교할 만한)·consistent(일관된)는 형태가 비슷한 함정.

items.q: Survey results indicate that customers value fast delivery ------- low prices.
items.ex: 동사 value의 정도를 비교하는 as much as(~만큼)가 정답. as many as는 셀 수 있는 명사의 수에, so much that은 결과절에 쓴다.

items.q: Due to unexpectedly high demand, the limited-edition headphones are currently on -------.
items.ex: on backorder는 '재고가 없어 입고 대기 중인'이라는 뜻으로 수요 급증과 맞는다. on standby는 사람·장비가 대기 중일 때 쓰여 문맥에 맞지 않는다.

items.q: ------- the number of online reviews has grown, so has the importance of responding to them promptly.
items.ex: As ~, so ...(~함에 따라 …도 그러하다) 구문으로 뒤의 so has와 짝을 이룬다. Despite는 전치사라 절을 이끌 수 없다.

items.q: All personnel must complete the cybersecurity course ------- than October 15.
items.ex: no later than(늦어도 ~까지)이 마감일 표현. no sooner는 'no sooner ~ than …(~하자마자)' 구문이라 의미가 다르다.

items.q: The architecture firm is seeking a project manager who is ------- in both Spanish and Portuguese.
items.ex: 언어에 '능숙한'은 proficient in. efficient(효율적인)는 철자가 비슷한 함정.

items.q: Mr. Brandt asked that his name be removed from the distribution list, ------- he no longer oversees the northern accounts.
items.ex: 뒤의 절이 이유를 나타내므로 접속사 since. due to는 전치사, therefore는 부사라 두 절을 잇지 못하고, so that은 목적을 나타낸다.

items.q: ------- interested in volunteering for the community cleanup should contact Ms. Ferreira by Friday.
items.ex: Those (who are) interested는 '관심 있는 사람들'이라는 관용 구문. Whoever는 뒤에 동사(is)가 있어야 해서 오답.

items.q: The upgraded charging stations are not only faster ------- more energy-efficient than the previous models.
items.ex: not only A but also B 상관접속사. as well as는 not only와 짝을 이루지 않는다.

items.q: The quarterly report, ------- was originally due last Monday, will now be released on Thursday.
items.ex: 콤마 뒤 계속적 용법의 주격 관계대명사는 which. that은 계속적 용법으로 쓸 수 없다.

items.q: Patrons are reminded that library materials not returned by the due date will be ------- a late fee.
items.ex: be subject to a fee(요금이 부과될 수 있다)가 정답. exempt from(~이 면제되는)은 연체라는 문맥과 정반대인 함정.

items.q: Each of the candidates ------- interviewed by a panel of three department heads next week.
items.ex: each of+복수명사는 단수 취급이고 next week가 미래이므로 will be. are는 복수 동사이고 were·have been은 시제가 맞지 않는다.

parts.name: Part 6
parts.dir: 지문의 빈칸 [1]~[4]에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 단어·어구·문장을 고르세요. 지문마다 문장을 고르는 문항이 하나씩 있습니다.

passages.body:
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Department
Date: May 18
Subject: New desk reservation system

Beginning next month, Brightwell Analytics will introduce a new desk reservation system for employees on a hybrid schedule. Rather than being assigned permanent workstations, staff members will [1] desks through the WorkNest app up to two weeks in advance. [2]

The change is intended to make better use of our office space, which has been largely [3] on Mondays and Fridays. Facilities manager Daniel Osei [4] a short demonstration of the app in the third-floor lounge on the first morning of the rollout. Those who are unable to attend will be able to view a recording on the company intranet.

qs.ex: 조동사 will 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 book. booking·booked는 will 뒤에 단독으로 올 수 없다.

o: The office will be closed for renovations during this period.
Many employees have asked for a larger parking area.
Please return your old laptop to the IT department by Friday.
Reservations that are not checked in by 10 A.M. will automatically be released to other users.
qs.ex: 앞 문장의 '앱으로 2주 전까지 좌석 예약'에 이어 예약 운영 규칙(10시까지 체크인 안 하면 자동 해제)을 덧붙이는 문장이 자연스럽다. 사무실 폐쇄 문장은 새 시스템 도입과 모순된다.
'공간을 더 잘 활용하려는' 목적이므로 월·금요일에 '덜 쓰이는' 상태였다는 underused가 맞다. overcrowded는 활용도를 높이자는 취지와 반대다.
문장만 보면 시제를 알 수 없지만, 시스템은 '다음 달부터' 시작되고 녹화본도 '볼 수 있을 것(will be able)'이므로 미래 will give. 과거 gave는 아직 시작 전인 문맥과 맞지 않는다.

passages.title: Article
passages.body:
PORTSMOUTH (May 4) — Halbrook Logistics announced on Tuesday that it has completed the [1] of its entire urban delivery fleet to electric vans. The company began replacing its diesel vehicles in 2023, and the final 40 vans [2] into service last week.

According to operations director Priya Raman, the switch has already lowered maintenance costs by nearly 30 percent. [3] “Our drivers also tell us the vans are quieter and more comfortable,” she added.

Halbrook now plans to install solar panels on the roof of its main depot. The panels will generate enough electricity to power roughly half of the company's charging stations, [4] its reliance on the regional power grid.

qs.ex: 정관사 the와 전치사 of 사이는 명사 자리이므로 conversion(전환). convertible은 형용사·명사지만 '오픈카'라는 의미라 문맥에 맞지 않는다.
차량이 운행에 '투입된' 수동 관계이고 last week가 과거이므로 were put. have put은 능동이며 last week와 함께 쓸 수 없다.

o: The company was founded by two brothers in 1998.
Diesel prices are expected to fall sharply next year.
Customers can now track their packages online.
Electric motors have far fewer moving parts than diesel engines, so they require less frequent servicing.
qs.ex: 바로 앞의 '정비 비용 30% 감소'에 대한 이유(전기 모터는 움직이는 부품이 적어 정비가 덜 필요)를 설명하는 문장이 이어져야 한다. 디젤 가격 문장은 전기차 전환 효과와 무관하다.
콤마 뒤에서 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문 thereby reducing(그로써 ~을 줄이며). reduces는 접속사 없이 동사가 하나 더 오게 되어 비문이다.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:
To: Leafbox Members

qs.ex: 앞 문장의 '완전 퇴비화 포장'을 구체적으로 풀어 설명(플라스틱 → 재활용 종이)하므로 Specifically. In contrast는 대조 관계일 때 쓴다.
이 문장만으로는 시제를 정할 수 없지만, 앞에서 '다가오는 변경(upcoming change)'이며 '7월 배송분부터' 적용된다고 했으므로 미래 will increase. 이미 오른 것처럼 보이는 increased·has increased는 함정.

o: Your June shipment has been delayed due to bad weather.
We have recently opened a retail store downtown.
Members on the Premium plan will not see any change in price.
Plastic packaging is cheaper and more durable.
qs.ex: Standard 요금 인상 직후에 다른 요금제(Premium)는 가격 변동이 없다는 보충 설명이 자연스럽다. 플라스틱이 더 싸고 튼튼하다는 문장은 친환경 전환을 알리는 글의 흐름에 어긋난다.
요금 인상을 알리며 '양해에 감사드린다'는 appreciate your understanding이 관용 표현. objection(반대)은 감사의 대상이 될 수 없다.

passages.title: Memo
passages.body:
To: Front Desk Team
From: Mariana Duque, Guest Relations Manager
Date: October 6
Subject: Review responses

Last month, our team began using ReplyWise, an AI tool that drafts responses to online guest reviews. Since then, our average response time [1] from four days to under twelve hours.

However, I have noticed that some responses are being posted without any changes to the AI-generated text. [2], several guests have commented that our replies seem generic. Please remember that ReplyWise is meant to provide a starting point, not a finished message. Each reply should mention at least one [3] detail from the guest's stay. [4]

qs.ex: Since then(그 이후로 지금까지)은 현재완료와 함께 쓰므로 has dropped. had been dropping은 과거의 기준 시점이 따로 있어야 한다.
AI 문장을 그대로 올린 '결과' 고객들이 답변이 천편일률적이라고 느낀 것이므로 As a result. Even so는 앞 내용과 반대될 때 쓴다.
명사 detail을 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 specific(구체적인). specifically는 부사라 명사를 수식할 수 없다.

o: Doing so shows guests that their feedback was actually read.
Doing so will lower the cost of our ReplyWise subscription.
Guests can now check in using a QR code at the front desk.
ReplyWise will be discontinued at the end of the month.
qs.ex: 앞 문장의 '투숙 중 구체적 사항을 하나 이상 언급하라'는 지시의 이유(리뷰를 실제로 읽었음을 보여 준다)를 밝히는 문장이 맞다. 도구 사용 중단 문장은 '출발점으로 쓰라'는 내용과 모순된다.

parts.name: Part 7
parts.dir: 지문을 읽고 각 질문에 가장 알맞은 답을 고르세요. 단일 지문 10개 → 이중 지문 2세트 → 삼중 지문 3세트 순서입니다.

That's it. Could you drop them off at their office on Pine Street? They're open until noon.

Marco Silva (9:18 A.M.)
I'm already on the highway.

Lena Park (9:19 A.M.)
Oh, no problem. I'll ask Jun to pick them up when he gets to the site at ten.

Marco Silva (9:20 A.M.)
Good idea. He drives right past Pine Street anyway.

qs.q: What is suggested about the tile samples?
o: They were delivered to the wrong address.
They are needed before a design can be finalized.
They are being kept in Ms. Park's office.
They must be returned to a supplier by noon.
qs.ex: 고객이 욕실 디자인을 '승인하기 전에' 샘플을 보고 싶어 한다고 했으므로 디자인 확정에 필요하다. 샘플은 현장 사무실(site office)에 있으므로 Ms. Park의 사무실이라는 보기는 함정.

qs.q: At 9:18 A.M., what does Mr. Silva most likely mean when he writes, “I'm already on the highway”?
o: He will arrive at Pine Street shortly.
He has already picked up the samples.
He is not able to make the delivery.
He is stuck in heavy traffic.
qs.ex: 이미 현장을 떠나 고속도로에 있다는 말은 샘플을 가지러 돌아갈 수 없다는 거절의 뜻이고, 바로 다음에 Ms. Park이 Jun에게 부탁하겠다고 한다. 교통 체증 이야기는 나오지 않는다.

passages.title: Notice
passages.body:

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:

passages.title: Article
passages.body:
Local Bakery Turns Reviews into Recipes
By Theo Marsh

CARRINGTON — When Dalia Ferrante opened Crumb & Kettle in 2021, she made a habit of reading every online review of her shop. “Most were kind, but the critical ones taught me more,” she says. [1]

One reviewer complained that the shop's sourdough was too sour for children. Rather than dismiss the comment, Ferrante developed a milder loaf, which is now the bakery's best seller. [2] Another customer asked for more vegan options; the bakery now offers four.

Ferrante's approach has paid off. Crumb & Kettle's average rating has risen from 3.9 to 4.7 stars, and the shop recently hired three additional bakers. [3] Next spring, Ferrante plans to open a second location near Carrington University. [4]

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: A bakery's move to a new neighborhood
How a business owner used customer comments to improve her products
The opening of a university cafeteria
A training program for new bakers
qs.ex: 리뷰를 읽고 덜 신 빵, 비건 메뉴를 만든 사례가 중심이므로 '고객 의견으로 제품을 개선한 방법'이 주제. 2호점은 '추가 개점 계획'이지 이전(move)이 아니다.

qs.q: What is indicated about Crumb & Kettle?
o: It has recently added to its staff.
qs.ex: 최근 제빵사 3명을 추가 채용했다(hired three additional bakers). 비건 메뉴는 4가지로 늘렸을 뿐 비건 전용 가게는 아니다.

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
“She even keeps a notebook of customer suggestions behind the counter.”
qs.ex: '심지어 손님 제안을 적는 노트까지 둔다'는 문장은 '비판적 리뷰에서 더 많이 배웠다'며 리뷰를 꼼꼼히 읽는 습관을 소개한 직후인 [1]에 와야 한다. even이 앞의 '모든 리뷰를 읽는 습관'을 강조하는 단서다.

passages.title: Article
passages.body:
Velora Motors Opens Charging Subscription to All Drivers

DETROIT (August 21) — Velora Motors announced yesterday that its ChargePass subscription, which gives electric-vehicle owners unlimited use of the company's fast-charging network for a flat monthly fee, will be available to drivers of all EV brands beginning in October. [1] Until now, the service had been limited to Velora owners.

The company says the change reflects a shift in how drivers think about charging. “People increasingly want predictable costs, the same way they pay for streaming or a phone plan,” said Carmen Ilves, Velora's head of energy services. [2]

ChargePass will cost $49 per month for Velora owners and $59 for drivers of other brands. Subscribers will also be able to reserve a charging bay up to an hour in advance through the Velora app, a feature that has proved popular during busy travel periods. [3]

Industry analyst Marcus Ode believes the move could put pressure on competitors. “Velora has the largest network in the region, with more than 900 stations,” he said. “Opening it to everyone gives the company a steady income stream that doesn't depend on selling cars.” [4]

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: The launch of a new electric-vehicle model
The opening of Velora's first charging station
A partnership between two car manufacturers
An existing service being offered to more customers
qs.ex: Velora 차주 전용이던 ChargePass를 10월부터 모든 브랜드 차주에게 개방한다는 기사다. 새 차종 출시나 첫 충전소 개설 이야기는 없다.

qs.q: According to Ms. Ilves, why are subscriptions appealing to drivers?
o: They can be shared with family members.
They make expenses easier to plan for.
They provide access to streaming services.
qs.ex: predictable costs(예측 가능한 비용)를 원한다고 했으므로 '지출을 계획하기 쉽다'가 패러프레이즈. streaming은 비유로 든 예일 뿐 혜택이 아니다.

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned about ChargePass?
o: Its price depends on the brand of vehicle.
It allows subscribers to reserve charging bays.
It provides unlimited use of fast chargers.
It offers a discount for annual payment.
qs.ex: 연간 결제 할인은 언급되지 않았다. 브랜드별 요금($49/$59), 충전 베이 예약, 무제한 이용은 모두 기사에 나온다.

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
“Over the Labor Day weekend last year, for example, more than 60 percent of available bays were booked through the app.”
qs.ex: for example로 '연휴 기간 앱으로 60% 이상 예약'이라는 사례를 드는 문장이므로, '바쁜 여행 시기에 인기를 끈 예약 기능'을 설명한 직후인 [3]이 맞다. [4]는 경쟁사 압박 이야기라 연결되지 않는다.

passages.title: Job advertisement

Job Opening: Sustainability Coordinator
Fennick Packaging Co.

Fennick Packaging, a manufacturer of food-grade containers based in Ashby, seeks a full-time Sustainability Coordinator to support our goal of using only recyclable materials in all of our products by 2028.

Responsibilities:
- Track energy and water use at our two production plants and prepare monthly reports
- Work with suppliers to identify lower-impact raw materials
- Coordinate employee training on waste-sorting procedures
- Prepare documentation for third-party environmental certifications

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in environmental science, engineering, or a related field
- At least two years of experience in a manufacturing or logistics setting
- Familiarity with data-visualization software is preferred but not required

This position follows a hybrid schedule: three days per week on-site, divided between our Ashby and Corwin plants, and two days remote. A company electric vehicle is provided for travel between sites.

To apply, upload a résumé and a one-page statement describing a sustainability project you have led at careers.fennickpack.com by May 20.

qs.q: What is a stated goal of Fennick Packaging?
o: To eliminate nonrecyclable materials from its products
To open a third production plant
To reduce the number of its suppliers
To earn its first environmental certification

qs.q: What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the position?
qs.ex: 생산직 채용은 업무 목록에 없다. 에너지·물 사용 추적(자원 소비 모니터링), 공급업체 협력, 직원 교육 조율은 모두 나와 있다.

It requires experience with data-visualization software.
It requires applicants to have their own vehicle.

qs.q: What must applicants submit?
o: A written account of a project they managed
qs.ex: 본인이 이끈 지속가능성 프로젝트를 설명하는 1쪽 분량의 글(statement)을 내야 한다. 월간 보고서는 입사 후 업무이지 제출 서류가 아니다.

qs.ex: [연계] 원래 주 2일(한 달 약 8일)을 예상했고 지금 요금제가 주 3일을 감당하지 못한다고 했으므로, 광고에서 '월 8일 이용'인 Flex Pass로 추론된다. 무제한인 Resident였다면 문제가 없었다.

qs.q: How much did Ms. Kowalczyk most likely pay for her first month?
qs.ex: [연계] 3월 중순(3월 31일 이전)에 가입해 첫 달 반값 혜택을 받았고, 현재 요금제가 Flex Pass($120)이므로 $60. Resident의 반값인 $155는 요금제를 잘못 추론했을 때의 함정.

qs.q: What does Ms. Kowalczyk ask about on behalf of a family member?
qs.ex: 여동생의 디자인 스튜디오를 위해 3인용 개인 사무실(private office)이 Kingsbridge 지점에 있는지 물었다. 회의실 시간은 본인 용도의 질문이다.

passages.title: Web page
passages.body:
PedalLoop — E-bike subscriptions in Marlow City

How it works: Choose a bike, pay monthly, and ride. Every plan includes maintenance, theft insurance, and a helmet.

Plans
Commuter — $39/month. Standard e-bike, 60 km range.
Cargo — $69/month. Front-loading cargo e-bike, 45 km range. Child seat available on request.
Folding — $49/month. Compact e-bike, 40 km range. Folds to fit on buses and trains.

Minimum term: 3 months. After that, cancel at any time with 14 days' notice.

Repairs: Book a repair through the PedalLoop app, and a technician will come to your home or workplace within 48 hours. If a repair cannot be completed in a single visit, the technician will leave you a replacement bike at no cost.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:
To: support@pedalloop.com
From: Owen Takahashi
Date: August 12
Subject: Repair visit

Hello,

I have been a PedalLoop subscriber for five months, and I use my bike every day to take my two-year-old daughter to day care, so I depend on it. Last Monday, the motor stopped working. I booked a repair through the app that evening, and a technician came on Wednesday morning. However, he told me that a replacement part had to be ordered, and he left without giving me another bike. I have been taking taxis since then, which has been expensive.

Please let me know when my bike will be fixed. I would also appreciate some compensation for the inconvenience. If this cannot be resolved soon, I may end my subscription.

Owen Takahashi

qs.q: According to the web page, what is included in every plan?
qs.ex: 모든 요금제에 정비, 도난 보험(theft insurance), 헬멧이 포함된다. 아동용 좌석은 Cargo 요금제에서 '요청 시' 제공된다.

qs.q: How much does Mr. Takahashi most likely pay each month?
qs.ex: [연계] 두 살 딸을 매일 어린이집에 태워 간다고 했으므로, 웹페이지에서 아동용 좌석을 제공하는 Cargo 요금제(월 $69)로 추론된다. 가장 기본인 Commuter($39)를 고르면 함정.

qs.q: What did PedalLoop fail to do?
o: Provide a temporary bike during a repair
Include a helmet with the subscription
qs.ex: [연계] 한 번 방문으로 수리가 끝나지 않으면 대체 자전거를 두고 가야 하는데, 기사는 부품 주문이 필요하다며 자전거 없이 떠났다. 월요일 저녁 예약 후 수요일 오전 방문이므로 48시간 규정은 지켰다.

qs.q: What is suggested about Mr. Takahashi?
o: He has already canceled his subscription.
He has completed the minimum subscription term.
He works as a bicycle technician.
qs.ex: 가입한 지 5개월이므로 최소 약정 3개월을 넘겼다(그래서 해지를 언급할 수 있다). 택시는 고장 이후 임시로 탄 것이지 평소 수단이 아니다.

qs.q: In the e-mail, the word “resolved” in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: If this cannot be resolved soon은 '문제가 해결되지 않으면'이라는 뜻이므로 settled. resolve가 '결심하다'일 때의 decided·determined는 문맥과 맞지 않는다.

passages.title: Memo
passages.body:
Ashgrove Consulting — Updated Business Travel Policy (effective May 1)

1. Rail travel is required for trips of less than 400 km, unless a client's needs make another option necessary.
2. Hotel stays are capped at $180 per night in most cities and $240 per night in London, New York, and Zurich.
3. Rental cars must be electric or hybrid. Charging costs may be claimed in the same way as fuel expenses.
4. All bookings must be made through the TravelDesk portal. Bookings made elsewhere will be reimbursed only with a manager's written approval.
5. Expense reports must be submitted within 10 business days of your return.

passages.title: Booking confirmation
passages.body:
TravelDesk — Booking Confirmation

Trip ID: TD-30917
Traveler: Sofia Brennan, Senior Analyst
Route: Lyon → Geneva (approx. 150 km)
Dates: May 13–15
Transportation: Rental car — Volkra E4 (electric), pickup at Lyon Part-Dieu Station
Hotel: Hotel Rive Claire, Geneva — 2 nights at $210 per night
Purpose: Client workshop, Moreau Pharmaceuticals
Status: Pending manager approval

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:
To: Graham Liu
From: Sofia Brennan
Date: May 4
Subject: Geneva trip

Hi Graham,

I've booked my trip for the Moreau workshop through TravelDesk, but two items need your sign-off.

First, I've reserved a car rather than taking the train. Moreau has asked me to visit its production sites in Annecy and Thonon on the way, and neither is easy to reach by rail.

Second, the hotel is over our nightly limit. However, it is the only one within walking distance of Moreau's office, and every cheaper option I found was at least 40 minutes away by bus.

I'll include my charging receipts with my expense report when I return.

Thanks,
Sofia

qs.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
o: To inform employees of revised travel rules
To announce the opening of a new office
To introduce a new online booking portal
To remind staff about an upcoming workshop
qs.ex: 제목이 '개정된 출장 규정(Updated Business Travel Policy)'이고 5월 1일부터 시행되는 규칙을 나열한다. TravelDesk는 규정 안에 언급된 기존 예약 수단일 뿐 새로 소개하는 것이 아니다.

qs.q: Why does Ms. Brennan's choice of transportation require approval?
o: Her rental car is not an electric model.
The distance of her trip falls under a set limit.
She booked the car outside of TravelDesk.
Her trip is longer than 400 km.
qs.ex: [연계] 규정상 400km 미만은 기차 이용이 원칙인데, 예약 확인서의 이동 거리가 약 150km라 렌터카는 예외 승인이 필요하다. 차량은 전기차(Volkra E4)라 규정에 맞는다.

qs.q: By how much does Ms. Brennan's hotel rate exceed the policy limit per night?
qs.ex: [연계] Geneva는 상한 240달러 도시 목록에 없으므로 일반 상한 180달러가 적용되고, 1박 210달러이므로 1박당 30달러 초과. 2박 합계 60달러와 혼동하지 말 것.

qs.q: What reason does Ms. Brennan give for her choice of hotel?
o: It offers a discount to corporate travelers.
It is close to the train station.
It is conveniently located near a client.
qs.ex: Moreau 사무실까지 걸어갈 수 있는 유일한 호텔이라고 했다. 전기차 충전은 호텔 선택 이유로 언급되지 않았다.

qs.q: What will Ms. Brennan most likely submit after her trip?
o: A written approval from Moreau Pharmaceuticals
qs.ex: 충전 영수증을 경비 보고서에 첨부하겠다고 했고, 규정 3번에 따라 충전 비용은 연료비처럼 청구할 수 있다. 기차는 타지 않으므로 기차표 영수증은 오답.

passages.title: Online review
passages.body:
★★☆☆☆ Reviewed by Cordelia P. — Posted April 22

I booked the chef's tasting menu through the restaurant's website a week ahead for my parents' anniversary. When we arrived on Saturday evening, the host could not find our reservation, and we waited 25 minutes for a table. The food itself was excellent, especially the smoked trout course, but the wait spoiled the start of the evening. We had also requested patio seating, but we were seated indoors next to the kitchen door.

passages.title: Owner's response
passages.body:
Response from Bastian Roe, Owner — April 23

Dear Cordelia,

Thank you for your feedback, and please accept my apologies. We have since discovered that an error in our new booking software caused a number of reservations made between April 10 and April 14 to be lost. The problem has now been fixed. As for the patio, it had been reserved that night for a private party, which our staff should have explained when you arrived.

I would like to invite you and your family back for a complimentary dessert course on your next visit. Please contact me directly at broe@oliveandember.com.

Bastian Roe

qs.q: What is indicated about Olive & Ember?
o: It is closed one day a week.
Its lunch set is served on weekends.
Its tasting menu does not require a reservation.
Its private dining room can hold 20 guests.
qs.ex: Closed Sundays이므로 일주일에 하루 휴무다. 테이스팅 메뉴는 24시간 전 예약이 필수이고, 개별 룸은 최대 14명이다.

qs.q: What did Cordelia P. praise?
o: The quality of a particular dish
qs.ex: 훈제 송어 코스(smoked trout course)를 특히 칭찬했다. 좌석 위치와 예약 시스템은 불만 사항이었다.

qs.q: Why was Cordelia P.'s reservation most likely missing?
o: It was made less than 24 hours in advance.
It was made for a Sunday.
It was made while a technical problem was occurring.
qs.ex: [연계] 리뷰에서 방문 일주일 전(4월 22일 게시, 방문은 그 전 토요일)에 웹사이트로 예약했다고 했고, 주인 답변에서 4월 10~14일 예약이 소프트웨어 오류로 사라졌다고 했다. 24시간 전 규정은 일주일 전에 예약했으므로 해당하지 않는다.

qs.q: What is true about the patio on the evening of Cordelia P.'s visit?
o: It had not yet reopened for the season.
It was open for the season but being used by another group.
It was closed because of bad weather.
It was available only for lunch.
qs.ex: [연계] 웹페이지상 테라스는 4월 15일 재개장이므로 방문일(4월 22일 이전 토요일)에는 이미 열려 있었고, 주인 답변대로 그날은 개인 파티 예약이 있었다. '아직 재개장 전'이 대표 함정.

qs.q: What does Mr. Roe offer Cordelia P.?
o: A discount on the private dining room
A free portion of a future meal
A reserved table on the patio
qs.ex: 다음 방문 때 무료 디저트 코스(complimentary dessert course)를 제공하겠다고 했다. 보증금은 개별 룸에만 해당하므로 환불 보기는 근거가 없다.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:
To: Department Heads
From: Helena Voss, Director of Operations
Date: January 8
Subject: MeetScribe pilot

Starting January 12, four departments will take part in a six-week pilot of MeetScribe, an AI tool that records meetings, produces transcripts, and generates lists of action items. The participating departments are Sales, Customer Support, Legal, and Product Design.

At the end of the pilot, staff in these departments will complete a short survey. If at least 70 percent of all respondents rate the tool as useful, we will purchase a company-wide license. Because of confidentiality requirements, MeetScribe must not be used in meetings with outside clients during the pilot period.

passages.title: Survey summary
passages.body:
MeetScribe Pilot — Survey Summary (February 27)

Department | Respondents | Rated “useful” | Most common comment
Sales | 22 | 82% | Action-item lists save time
Customer Support | 30 | 77% | Transcripts help train new staff
Legal | 8 | 38% | Concerned about where recordings are stored
Product Design | 15 | 87% | Would like it to connect with our sketching software
Overall | 75 | 76% |

passages.title: E-mail
passages.body:
To: All Staff
From: Helena Voss, Director of Operations
Date: March 6
Subject: MeetScribe

I'm pleased to announce that, following a successful pilot, MeetScribe will be available to all employees beginning April 1. Training sessions will be held during the last two weeks of March.

One department will not adopt the tool for now. Its manager has asked that we first review how and where recordings are stored, and our IT team is working with the vendor on a solution.

In addition, starting in May, MeetScribe will connect directly with DrawBoard, our design platform, in response to feedback we received during the pilot.

qs.q: According to the first e-mail, what restriction applied during the pilot?
o: Only department heads could use the tool.
The tool could not be used in meetings with external clients.
Meetings could last no longer than six weeks.
Transcripts had to be reviewed by the IT team.
qs.ex: 기밀 유지 때문에 외부 고객과의 회의에서는 사용하지 못하게 했다. six weeks는 시범 운영 '기간'이지 회의 길이가 아니다.

qs.q: Why did the company decide to buy a license for MeetScribe?
o: Every department rated the tool as useful.
The vendor offered a discount after the pilot.
The overall approval rating exceeded a target set in advance.
The Legal department recommended the purchase.
qs.ex: [연계] 첫 이메일에서 전체 응답자의 70% 이상이 유용하다고 하면 구매한다고 했고, 설문 요약의 전체 수치가 76%이다. Legal은 38%로 낮았으므로 '모든 부서'는 함정.

qs.q: Which department will most likely not use MeetScribe beginning on April 1?
qs.ex: [연계] 3월 6일 이메일에서 녹음 저장 위치 검토를 요청한 부서가 도입을 보류한다고 했고, 설문 요약에서 그 우려를 낸 부서는 Legal이다.

qs.q: Which department's feedback most likely led to the connection with DrawBoard?
qs.ex: [연계] DrawBoard는 디자인 플랫폼이며, 설문에서 '스케치 소프트웨어와 연동되면 좋겠다'는 의견을 낸 부서가 Product Design이다.

qs.q: In the e-mail dated March 6, the word “review” in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: 녹음 파일을 어떻게, 어디에 저장하는지 먼저 '검토하다'라는 뜻이므로 examine. review를 '비평하다'로 보아 criticize를 고르면 함정.
